intro: Elder Riversong is an ancestral night elf spirit honored during the Lunar Festival, found resting beneath a quiet shrine in Astranaar. Bathed in a beam of moonlight, she offers quiet wisdom to travelers and directs pilgrims toward other revered ancestors across the lands of Kalimdor.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The heavens, in their countless stars, hold answers to earthly mysteries, friend. Might, then, the wise, and the lucky, gaze up and find truth?
